div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://smart.who.int/base/CodeSystem/participant-role defines the following codes:

tr.td: An intermediary that bridges between networks or domains (e.g., XCA gateway, national contact point).
A routing or orchestration intermediary (e.g., message broker, integration engine, central services hub).
A transparent intermediary acting on behalf of the initiator or responder.
An actor that receives information about the interaction without affecting it (e.g., audit repository).
An actor that provides authorization decisions or tokens.
An actor (often human) that performs the action requested by the interaction.
An actor that validates content or identity during the interaction.
